_README: THE EDGES. Corner rounding, line weights, shadow, motion, focus ring.
AN ABSENT KEY INHERITS. A PRESENT KEY WINS.
`shadow: none` is a real value, not an absent one -- writing it out is how
you say 'deliberately off' rather than 'not mentioned'.
`focus-w` is the keyboard focus ring. Never 0.

_base.note: The fallback every other row lands on. Must be complete.

hairline.note: The house feel. Barely rounded, flat, one-pixel rules. A reference database, not a card UI.

square.note: No rounding anywhere. Reads as a printed form.

soft.note: Rounded and lifted. Included so the difference is visible, not because this site wants it. NOT the ClickUp_apps `soft` preset -- that one also carries an elevation scale and a motion set this repo never ported.
